# Shadcn OpenTUI

Shadcn OpenTUI is an independent browser/web implementation that brings OpenTUI-style terminal interfaces into React and shadcn/ui applications.

Canonical project repository: https://github.com/canadian-ai/shadcn-opentui
Issue tracker and feature requests: https://github.com/canadian-ai/shadcn-opentui/issues
OpenTUI source repository: https://github.com/tyrellshawn/opentui

## Documentation

Documentation home: /docs
Terminal component: /docs/components/terminal
Installation: /docs/installation
Quick start: /docs/quick-start
Themes: /docs/themes
Plugins: /docs/plugins

## Registry

Terminal registry endpoint: /api/registry/terminal
Registry metadata: /registry/index.json

For bugs, feature requests, component requests, and agent-generated improvement proposals, use the canonical project issue tracker above so work can be inspected and tracked publicly.
